name: realbrowser-mcp-gateway
description: Lets AI agents read the web through your own real browser: pages, search and files, via a local daemon, a Firefox-family add-on and an MCP helper

scripts.lint: find $(ls -d daemon extension tools tests 2>/dev/null) -type f -name '*.*js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n 1 node --check && python3 -c "import ast; [ast.parse(open(f).read(), f) for f in ('cli/bgw', 'cli/bgw_daemonctl.py')]" && tsc -p jsconfig.json
